change: Gather already-queued control frames into one bounded vectored write and flush; retain the eight-frame reply window, FIFO authentication, original deadlines and physical ownership.

regression.red: Eight ready authenticated control frames use eight writes, failing the one-write bound.
regression.green: Production sender coalesces all eight with exact frame ordering/authentication/replies; one-byte duplex progress and existing failure/revocation/deadline/shutdown cases pass.
regression.first_full_suite: 518 passed, one-byte duplex test exceeded its unchanged three-second deadline. Counting adapter copied the entire remaining window for each one-byte write.
regression.repair: Bounded test-adapter gathering by actual duplex capacity, removing quadratic copying without changing its timeout, byte capacity or assertions. Full rerun passes.

limits: No end-to-end throughput or latency gain established yet.
Gathering ends queue timing earlier; compare exchange timing and client outcomes to distinguish reduced work from moved waiting.
Vectored-count regression uses a real duplex stream with a counting adapter; real TLS protocol tests qualify correctness separately.
